name: dai-cg-priv4
command: exec > /out/cg-priv4.txt 2>&1; echo '== nsroot subtree_control BEFORE =='; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control; echo '== enable at nsroot =='; (echo '+cpu +memory +pids' > /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control) 2>&1; echo rc=$?; echo '== AFTER =='; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control; echo; echo '== mkdir s2 + controllers =='; mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/s2; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/cgroup.controllers; echo; echo '== write limits =='; (echo max > /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/memory.max) 2>&1; echo "mem rc=$?"; (echo 100 > /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/pids.max) 2>&1; echo "pids rc=$?"; echo '-- values:'; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/memory.max /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/pids.max 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '== move proc =='; sleep 120 & SP=$!; sleep 1; (echo $SP > /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/cgroup.procs) 2>&1; echo "move rc=$?"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/cgroup.procs 2>/dev/null; kill $SP 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; echo; echo '== nested child for leaf limits =='; mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/n1 2>/dev/null && echo NESTED_OK; (echo '+cpu +memory' > /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/cgroup.subtree_control) 2>&1; echo "s2ctl rc=$?"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/cgroup.subtree_control; rmdir /sys/fs/cgroup/s2/n1 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '== cleanup =='; rmdir /sys/fs/cgroup/s2 2>&1 && echo RMDIR_OK || echo RMDIR_FAIL; echo done
